answer: Each agent ID has to keep answering random peer-graded tasks, and every answer has to come from fresh inference. A farm can't reuse the same outputs, because peers embed every answer and reject any pair that's too similar. So ten fakes need ten real model runs per round, a hundred fakes need a hundred, and the GPU bill goes up with every one. One round might ask why an oasis town levies water rights. The next might ask how yarrow spreads through a meadow. Prompts are drawn per ID from a beacon, so there's nothing to precompute or buy in bulk.
